description: Dispatch timestep definition and granularity label
notes: Hourly first and quarter-hour later

description: Optimisation horizon definition such as D_only or later D_plus_4
notes: DST-safe handling required later

description: Forecast-origin gate closure and settlement timing conventions
notes: Must preserve non-anticipativity and DA timing

description: Scenario probabilities for stochastic DA optimisation
notes: Not required before stochastic phase

description: Configuration-level route availability and enabled process blocks
notes: Baseline BF-BOF and later Phase 1 hybrid must stay explicit

description: Boundary rule for internal balances and allowed external imports or exports
notes: Do not imply full site digital twin

description: Policy for non-modelled residual electricity demand
notes: Residual loads must be explicit rather than ignored

description: Chosen production target metric for the phase
notes: Target policy must be frozen before coding

description: Product family or grade-mix abstraction used in the model
notes: Keep as exogenous or banded until stronger evidence exists

description: Public or assumed route-share anchor used only for validation or sensitivity
notes: Do not treat as approved operating input without review

description: Minimum and maximum throughput by process block
notes: Shared downstream capacities must also be captured

description: Availability or outage status by period
notes: Public support likely coarse only

description: Ramping or minimum stable load logic for selected units
notes: EAF and major utility users likely need explicit treatment later

description: Input recipe coefficients by process and route
notes: Keep units explicit and route-specific

description: Yield loss and by-product coefficients per process block
notes: High-risk family for fake feasibility if omitted

description: Grade or quality-linked recipe bounds for scrap DRI or route usage
notes: Reserve for later once evidence improves

description: Definitions and units for electricity gas steam oxygen hydrogen nitrogen water and similar carriers
notes: Needed for schema consistency before values

description: Carrier consumption coefficients by process block
notes: Should not enter approved tables without stable source support

description: Definitions and routing logic for BFG COG BOF/LD gas and mixed-gas handling
notes: Explicitly reserve category even if first LP aggregates it

description: Holder capacity throughput and spill or flare treatment
notes: Needed to avoid free-battery behaviour

description: Storage identity and policy for scrap DRI slab WIP oxygen and gas holders
notes: Store semantics must be explicit

description: Initial and terminal inventory rules plus anti-arbitrage treatment
notes: Terminal conditions required to stop intertemporal arbitrage

description: Penalty or dwell rule for thermal state or reheating effects
notes: Later proxy to avoid unrealistic hot-material storage freedom

description: Technical or contracted site import bounds
notes: Public topology exists but detailed contract economics may not

description: Capacity-charge tariff and peak-cost categories
unit: EUR per MW or EUR per MWh
notes: Keep separate from physical coefficients

description: Emissions factors by process or carrier
notes: Direct and indirect treatment must stay explicit

description: ETS free-allocation and carbon-cost convention used by the model
notes: Must be frozen per experiment and disclosed

description: Raw-material utility and operating cost families used in the objective
notes: Economic drivers likely sensitive and source-mixed

description: Product revenue or shortfall penalty categories used to enforce delivery logic
notes: Keep target fulfilment and economics separable

description: Policy for submitted DA quantities prices or cleared-consumption representation
notes: Explicit bidding representation required before claim of DA participation

description: Realised procurement clearing and settlement parameters
notes: Realised settlement must be reported separately from optimisation expectation

description: Scenario-sharing set for first-stage decisions
notes: Must not be bypassed in scenario optimisation

description: VaR threshold excess-loss confidence-level and risk-weight families
notes: Validation-based selection only

description: Reserve capacity activation and penalty category family
notes: Explicitly deferred until DA-only steel is stable

description: Public throughput or annual production anchor used for plausibility checking
notes: Validation target only and not an approved operating coefficient

notes: Supports order-of-magnitude validation only
